changes.title: Trail path
items: Your trail now follows the path of your dodges exactly, corners and all: dodge in a ^ and the trail draws the ^.

changes.title: Bark off indoors
items: Inside the treehouse the oak's faint bark is gone: no more dark patch over the cauldron or dark band across the floor (the pause page's "Bark left indoors" slider still brings it back).

changes.title: Telephone recovery attempt
items: Reconnecting a call gives slow connections time to respond.

changes.title: Feed key
items: The berry you'd feed now glows brighter, with just the button (E, or your controller's) over it and a little arrow pointing at it: no words
An animal you've told to eat a berry goes and eats it before it joins any fight, then fights as usual
